scgpt.dtype: bf16 autocast with fp32 loss and optimizer
scgpt.optimizer: Adam, StepLR gamma 0.9, gradient norm clipping 1

gears.optimizer: Adam with weight decay 0.0005, StepLR gamma 0.5, gradient value clipping 1
gears.coexpression: Absolute Pearson from train single-intervention expression only, incoming top 21 and threshold > 0.4; same graph on each cell in the batch
gears.go: Author GO prior, incoming top 21 within the shared output gene set

loss: Mean squared post-treatment expression residual, on all output genes for GEARS and up to 1536 sampled genes per scGPT train batch with all targets forced in
model_selection: Select epoch on validation macro delta RMSE only. In the M/D screens score no test outcomes. Preserve equal example/update opportunity; record actual exposure and early stopping.

data_modes.D0: Fixed control pairs and shuffled train cells exactly once per epoch
data_modes.D1: Same train cells, shuffle and budget; hash a new control assignment per epoch
data_modes.D2: Same total examples; intervention counts differ by at most one per epoch. Permute each condition's cells and cycle through if needed, using original fixed control IDs
